LITHIUM. 

BUT AS LONG AGO AS 1946, DRe HANS THIRRING, AN AUSTRIAN PHYSICIST, 
THEORIZED IN PRINT THAT A-80MBS COULD BE USED TO TRIGGER LITHIUM AND 
HYDROGEN INTO FUSION EXPLOSIONe ONLY AN A-BOMB BLAST CAN PRODUCE : 
HEAT GREAT ENOUGH TO START THE BIGGER FUSION BLAST. THE TRIGGER 7 
BOMB CAN BE A SMALL ONE. e 

WITH NO ACCESS TO SECRET INFORMATION, DRe THIRRING SAID ONE Fe 
KILOGRAM OF LITHIUM AND HYDROGEN WOULD PRODUCE THREE TIMES 4S MUCH | 
ENERGY IN EXPLOSION AS AN EQUAL MASS OF URANIUM. 

HE ALSO SAID AS MANY TONS OF LITHIUM WERE AVAILABLE FOR USE IN 
SUPER BOMBS AS KILOGRAMS OF URANIUM FOR *"ORDINARY* A-BOMBS. 

THE BULLETIN OF THE ATOMIC SCIENTISTS WAITED FOUR YEARS TO REPRINT 
THIRRING BECAUSE, THE EDITOR EXPLAINED, SUCH PUBLICATION MIGHT MAKE 
THE WORLD THINK THE UNITED STATES WAS BEVELOPING THERONUCLEAR WEAPONS. 

IT DID REPRINT THIRRING IN MARCH, 1950, AFTER WORD OF THE H-BOMB 
EFFORT LEAKED OUT. Nhe

Asa OT OR COLD, THE LIGHTEST OF METALS HAS BEEN MINED FOR MANY YEARS. 
IT WAS DISCOVERED IN SWEDEN IN 1313. NEARLY A CENTURY PASSED 
BEFORE COMMERCIAL USES BECAME IMPORTANT. 

Now IT'S USED FOR CERAMICS AND GLASS WHICH MUST WITHSTAND GREAT 
HEAT. IT'S USED IN MAKING VITAMINS AND ANTIHISTAMINES, FOR LUBRI- 
PANTS, IN AIR CONDITIONING UNITS, AND IN METALLURGY FOR DENSE CASTINGS 
OF COPPER AND BRONZE AND FOR WELDING ALUMINUM. 

IT'S USED FOR THE RED COLOR IN FLARES, FEREWORKS AND SIGNAL) © 
ROCKETS. THE VERSATILE USE LIST INCLUDES ALSO DENTAL CEMENT 

PING MEATS.

AS A GROUP OF INSURGENTS, THE TOP REDS TRACE BACK TO THE 1920S. 
THEY DIDN'T START RUNNING CHINA UNTIL 1949. 

THEY WORSHIP MARX AND ENGELS, LENIN AND STALIN. BUT THEY ALSO 
CLAIM SUN YAT-SEN IN THEIR POLITICAL ANCESTRY. SUN LED THE 
REVOLUTION THAT OVERTHREW THE MANCHUS AND ENDED THE DYNASTIES, AT 
LEAST THE OLD STYLE DYNASTIES. . 

SUN'S REVOLUTION STARTED IN 1911. ONCE IT SPLIT INTO LOOSE 
FEDERALISMS, THE WAR LORDS. THAT WAS WHERE CHIANG KAI-SHEK CAME IN. 
HE HEADED SUN'S ARMIES AND PARTY, DEFEATED THE WAR LORDS AND UNIFIED 
THE COUNTRY. 

CHIANG MADE USE OF THE COMMUNISTS WHILE DOING THIS. THAT'S ABOUT 
THE ONLY SOLID LINK MAO TZE-TUNG'S REGIME HAS WITH SUN YAT-SEN. 

BUT SUN I$ THE GREAT MODERN PATRIOT TO MILLIONS OF CHINESE. AND 
COMMUNISM LIKES TO LINK ITSELF WITH GREAT PATRIOTS, SPECIALLY DEAD 
ONES WHO CAN'T DENY THE CONNECTION. 

ONE OF THE FIRST THINGS THE REDS DID IN 1949 WAS TO PUT SUN'S 
WIDOW, THE ELDEST OF THE SOONG SISTERS, IN THEIR GOVERNMENT: | 

SHE WASN'T A PARTY MEMBER, BUT PEIPING GETS AROUND THINGS L

GARGANTUA OF THE EAST--CRASHES THE DIPLOMATIC 


___ WHAT FOLLOWED iWiA$ ONE OF THOSE HUMAN EPICS THAT Go WITH MASSIVE 
DETERMINATIONS, LOST CAUSES, GREAT DEVOTION OR GREAT DESPAIR» 

WAS THE LONG Marcu. (CAPS LM) SOME 20,000 STARTED WALKINGe 

3,000 OF THEM SURVIVED 3 ,000 MOUNTAINOUS, MARSHY, PERILOUS MILES OF 
ILLNESS, AMBUSY AND DEATH. WHETHER IT wAS A LAST-DITCH DEVOTION OR 
AN INSTINCTIVE MIGRATION, IT SAVED CHINA COMMUNISM. 

THE 5,000 FINALLY SETTLED IN 4 DRY AND DISTANT NOOK AT THE EDGE 
OF INNER MONGOLIA AROUND THE CAVE CITY OF YENAN. THERE THEY SPAWNED 
THE GREATEST POSTWAR POLITICAL-MILITARY FORCE OF THE EAST. A DOZEN 
YEARS AND A WORLD WAR LATER THE 5,000, GROWN TO SEVERAL MILLIONS, 
OVERRAN CHINA AND GAVE COMMUNISM {TS GREATEST TRIUMPH SINCE 1917. 

THE LEADER WAS MAO TZE-TUNG, A RESTLESS, NOT-TOO-ROBUST, FAT MAN 
HE WAS BORN A HUNAN FARM BOY WITH MORE INTELLIGENCE THAN, EDUCATIONAL 
CHANCE TO SATISFY IT, HE DISCOVERED MARX WHILE VORKING/¥S) A 
LI BR. 4 

MAO LOOKED AT CHINA'S 400 MILLION PEASANTS, MANY WORRENG FOR 
LANDLORDS. INSTEAD OF PROMISING TO STRIKE OFF THE CHAINS OFTHE 
[INDUSTRIAL PROLETARIAT, HE PROMISED TO GIVE LAND TO THE LANDLESS.» 

HE DIDN'T MAKE GOOD ON’THE PROMISE VERY WELL, BUT AS A REVOLUTIONARY 
RALLYING FORCE, IT WORKED. 

ONCE IN POWER, MAO--THAT BENEVOLENT OLD LAND REFORMER, 4S MANY 
VIEWED HIM--TURNED INTO 4 BLOODY PRACTITIONER OF THE CLASSLESS CREED. 
HE GOT LESS PUBLICITY THAN STALIN, aUT HE KILLED MORE "ENEMIES OF 

THE 1951-52 PURGE OF COUNTER REVOLUTIONARIES, THE SLAUGHTER OF 
THE LANDLORDS, THE CRACKDOWN ON PRIVATE OWNERS, ALONG WITH ALL THE 
LESSER ELIMINATIONS, RESULTED IN POLITICAL KILLINGS POSSIBLY UP TO 
15 MILLIONS. NO ONE KNOWS HOW MANY WENT TO WORK CAMPS.

THE 5-YEAR PLAN IS AN ALL-OUT RUSH JOB TO BUILD HEAVY INDUSTRY 
AND AT THE SAME TIME CREATE A WORKER CLASS WHICH IN TURN--SAYS THE 
BOOK--WILL MAKE POSSIBLE SOCIALISM AND, EVENTUALLY, COMMUNISM.

AFTER IT STARTED THE PLAN LAST YEAR.

IF COMMUNISM WAS THROWN OUT OF CHINA TOMORROW, THREE LASTING 
BENEFITS WOULD BE LEFT BEHIND. 

ONE IS THE RAILROADS. THE JAPANESE WAR AND THE CIVL WAR RIPPED 
UP SO MANY LINES SO THOROUGHLY THAT IN 1949 YOU COULDN'T EVEN LOCATE 
SOME OF THE ROADBEDS. RAILS AND TIES HAD DISAPPEARED. YET THE REDS 
BUILT THEM BACK IN A FEW MONTHS AND OPERATE THEM WELL» 

THEY RESTORED ROADS JUST AS QUICKLY AND REDUCED CHINA'S CHRONIC 
BANDIT TROUBLES SO THAT THEY COULD BE SAFELY USED. 

SINCE THEN THEY HAVE BUILT NEW ROADS AND RAILROADS BUT TOO OFTEN | 
WITH AN EYE TO MILITARY AND POLITICAL NEEDS RATHER THAN THE COUNTRY’S 
ECONOMY. LATER BENEFITS ARE MIXED. THE REDS HAVE SPENT MONEY : 
AND LIVES--THE PURGES SUPPLY THEM WITH PLENTY OF SLAVE LABOR--BUILDING 
ROADS INTO TIBET AND RAILROADS INTO CHINESE TURKESTAN. OTHER AREAS 
NEEDED THEM. BUT TIBET FRINGES ON INDIA AND SOUTH ASIA, AND 
CHINESE TURKESTAN BORDERS THE SOVIET. 

PEIPING'S FLOOD CONTROL WORK IS ANOTHER UNDENIABLE BOON. NO LAND 
SUFFERS SO MUCH FROM FLOODS. THE REDS TACKLED THE TOUGHEST RIVERS 
WITH SELF-CONFIDENCE. THEY SAY THEY HAVE TAMED THE VICIOUS HWET, 
BETWEEN THE YANGTZE AND THE YELLOW. THEY HAVE CERTAINLY DONE A 
LOT OF PICK AND SHOVEL WORK, AGAIN WITH POLITICAL LABOR. BUT 
SOMETIMES IT SOUNDS LIKE TOO MUCH DIKING AND NOT ENOUGH DAMMING. 

THE COMMUNISTS HAVE POSSIBLY 10 MILLION MEN UNDER SOME DEGREE OF 
ARMS. MOST OF THEM ARE THE MILITIA, REGIONAL SECURITY TROOPS AND 
VARIOUS SPECIALIZED FORCES. THE STRIKING POWER--THE PEOPLE'S 
LIBERATION ARMY--WAS ESTIMATED AT THE START OF THE KOREAN WAR AT 1 
\BOUT 2.1/2 MILLION MEN DIVIDED INTO FIVE FIELD ARMIES. O54 

IT SEEMS TO BE LARGER NOW, MAYBE UPWARD OF 3 MILLION. =o 

MANPOWER IS UNLIMITED BUT INDOCTRINATION IS A DELAYERe BEFORE 
You GIVE MEN ARMS UNDER COMMUNISM, YOU HAVE TO BE SURE THEY ARE 

NIST- INCLINED. 

IN 1950, THE RED ARMY WAS REGARDED POLITICALLY SOLID. KOREA _ 
DECIMATED THE 4TH AND MAYBE THE 32D FIELD ARMIES. THEY HAD TO B 
FILLED IN FAST AND THE IDEOLOGICAL LEVEL WENT DOWN.

THE COMMUNIST ARMIES ENTERED KOREA FROM THE CHINA CIVIL WAR 
WHERE ‘THE RIFLEMAN WAS SUPREME. LIN PIAO, 4 TOUGH FIELD GENERAL, 
COMMANDED, HE MADE UP FOR LACK OF FIRE POWER AGAINST THE MODERN 
UNITED NATIONS FORCES BY HUMAN SEA TACTICS. MEANWHILE WITH RUSSIAN 
HELP. THE CHINESE ARMY MODERNIZED AND BY 1953 IT WAS MATCHING 
FIREPOWER WITH FIREPOWER. 

TODAY PEIPING'S ARMIES ARE PARTLY MODERN, PARTLY OLD. ABOUT 50 
DIVISIONS, EQUIPPED WITH RUSSIAN ARTILLERY AND VEHICLES, REPLACEABLE 
ONLY FROM RUSSIA--ARE RATED UP-TO-DATE BY ANY STANDARD. 

THE 100 OR MORE OTHER DIVISIONS ARE SUPPOSED TO BE IN THE HOPPER 
VOW FOR MODERNIZATION. IT COSTS A LOT AND CHINA IS NOT RICH. 

[N FACT PEIPING JUST FINISHED ANOTHER BOND DRIVE WHICH WAS 
OVERSUBSCRIBED BY ONLY 7 PER CENT, HARDLY PAR FOR THE MAQ COURSE. 
\N AIR FORCE OF 2,000 PLANES IS INCLUDED. IF THEY BRING THE WHOLE 
THING UP TO MODERN LEVELS, THE STRAIN WILL BE TERRIFIC. 

BUT ON THE OTHER HAND, THE EFFECT WOULD ALSO BE TERRIFIC. THEY 
JOULD THEN HAVE SUCH POWER THEY MIGHT BE ABLE TO GET WHAT THEY WANT 
[IN ASIA WITHOUT USING IT. 

A HISTORIC FEAR IS ON THE THRESHOLD OF REALITY--THE FEAR THAT 
SOME DAY A TYRANT WOULD EFFECTIVELY HARNESS THE MANPOWER OF CHINA.

Sg as 23 CAP)-BRITAIN HAS LAUNCHED A DIPLOMATIC 


CAMPAIGN TO WIN THE SUPPORT OF FIVE ASIAN NATIONS FOR THE WEST'S 
PROPOSED "SOUTHEAST ASIA NATO," BRITISH OFFICIALS SAID TONIGHT. 

BRITISH ENVOYS WERE REPORTED PUSHING THE PLAN. STRESSING ITS 
DEFENSIVE NATURE, IN BEHIND-THE-SCENES TALKS IN INDIA, PAKISTAN 
AND CEYLON. THE BRITISH HOPE IS THAT THESE THREE BRITISH 
COMMONWEALTH COUNTRIES WILL GO ALONG AND ALSO WIN OVER BURMA AND 

N 

INDIA, STRIVING FOR NEUTRALITY IN THE COLD WAR, ALREADY HAS 
REACTED GOLDLY. THE REACTION OF PAKISTAN AND CEYLON HAS BEEN 
CAUTIOUS. 

THE PRIME MINISTERS OF THESE FIVE COUNTRIES WILL MEET: NEXT 
WEDNESDAY IN COLOMBO, CEYLON'S CAPITAL, TO DISCUSS ASIAN PROBLEMS 
GENERALLY. THE SOUTHEAST ASIAN NATO PLAN IS ALMOST CERTAIN TO BE 
EXANINED THERE, TOGETHER WITH INDOCHINESE WAR AND KOREAN PEACE 
QUESTIONS. 

PUBLICLY. FOREIGN SECRETARY ANTHONY EDEN HAS COMMITED BRITAIN 
ONLY TO EXAMINE THE IDEA. THE PROPOSAL WAS DISCLOSED AFTER HIS TALKS 
HERE EARLIER THIS MONTH WITH UseSe SECRETARY OF STATE DULLES. 

THE FEELING IN OFFICIAL BRITISH CIRCLES IS THAT THE PLAN CAN BE 
MADE TO WORK SUCCESSFULLY IF IT RECEIVES WIDE ASIAN SUPPORT. 

BRITAIN ALWAYS HAS REGARDED AS INADEQUATE THE PRESENT ALLIED _-— 
DEFENSE ARRANGEMENTS IN THE FAR EAST. SOME BRITONS HAVE VOICED 
RESENTMENT BECAUSE THIS NATION WAS EXCLUDED FROM ANZUS, THE PACIFIC 
DEFENSE PACT LINKING AUSTRALIA, NEW ZEALAND AND THE UNITED STATES. 

FOR MONTHS BRITAIN HAS BEEN WORKING QUIETLY ON PLANS FOR A 
WIDER GROUPING OF LIKE-MINDED ALLIED AND ASIAN STATES IN 
SOUTHEAST ASIA AND THE WESTERN PACIFIC. THESE STATES, IN THE 
BRITISH VIEW. WOULD WORK TOGETHER NOT ONLY TO PROTECT THE VITAL 
REGIONAL AGAINST COMUNISM BUT ALSO TO STEP UP ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL 


COOPERATION AND SO RAISE LIVING STANDARDS.»

ADVANCE PA! APRIL 23 (AP)-DIEN BIEN PHU HAS BECOME A BATTLE- 

FIELD FOR FRENCH MORALE--AN INSPIRATION IF IT HOLDS, 4 SHOCKER IF IT 

PATHE FORTRESS WAS DESIGNED ORIGINALLY FOR TWO MAIN PURPOSES: TO BLOCK 

A MAJOR VIETMINH SUPPLY ROUTE FROM RED CHINA THROUGH THE THAI TRIBAL 

COUNTRY, AND TO INVITE A FACE-TO-FACE BATTLE BETWEEN THE DISCIPLINED 

AND HEAVILY GUNNED FRENCH AND THE JUNGLE-TRAINED VIETMINHe THE REBEL 

TROOPS USUALLY FIGHT FROM TREE TO HUMMOCK LIKE INDIANS WHO RAIDED THE 
LGRIM SETTLEMENTS. 

THE VIETMINH BUILT SUPPLY TRAILS AND BYPASSED THE FORTRESS. 

BUT THE BIG MISCALCULATION WAS THAT THE VIETMINH WOULD NOT HAVE 
GOOD FIELD AND ANTI-AIRCRAFT ARTILLERY. THIS TURNED THE BATTLE INTO A 
FAR MORE SERIOUS AFFAIR TO THE FRENCH THAN HAD BEEN ANTICIPATED. 

EVEN BEFORE THE FIRST “HUMAN WAVE" ATTACK AGAINST THE FORTRESS ON 
MARCH 13 IT BECAME CLEAR THE VIETMINH HAD PLENTY OF FIELD AND ANTI- 
AIRCRAFT GUNS. THAT CHANGED THE ENTIRE OUTLOOK, BUT THE FRENCH COULD 
NOT CHANGE THEIR MIND. 


THERE IS NO GETTING OUT OF DIEN BIEN PHU SHORT OF A DECISIVE 
VICTORY, OR AN ARMISTICE. 

WHEN A SIMILAR BATTLE WAS MOUNTED AT NA SAN A YEAR AGO, THE FRENCH 
WERE ABLE TO PROTECT THEIR AIRSTRIP SO SUPPLIES COULD BE FLOWN IN 
AND THE WOUNDED FLOWN OUT. THAT DOESN'T WORK AT DIEN BIEN PHU. ANTI- 
AIRCRAFT WEAPONS, GUIDED BY RADAR WHICH PERMITS THEM TO HIT PLANES EVEN 
IN THE DARK OF NIGHT, MAKES USE OF THE AIRSTRIP IMPOSSIBLE AND AIR 
DROPPING VERY HAZARDOUS. 

AN ESTIMATED 50 PLANES HAVE BEEN LOST IN THE AIRLIFT--a Aug Rp 
TO 4 HALF SHOT DOWN AT THE FORTRESS SITE. 7g 


4126 
NOW THE VIETMINH ARE PURSUING ANCIENT SIEGE TACTICS, VARYING ONLY 
IN DETAILS FROM THE SIEGE THAT BROKE GENeCORNWALLIS’ DERENSE OF YORK- 
TOWN IN THE AMERICAN REVOLUTIONARY WAR. FOOT BY FOOT THE BESIEGERS 

DIG THEIR APPROACH TRENCHES NEARER THE FINAL DEFENSE TO GET SET For 4 
RUSH AND A BREAKTHROUGH. BY DAY AND BY NIGHT THE MEN WITHIN THF For- 

SS, JUST AS AT YORKTOWN, RUSH OUT TO DRIVE BACK THE ADVANCING 
TRENCHERS. BUT THE NUMBERS ARE ALWAYS GREATER OUTSIDE THAN INSIDE. 

IN DIEN BIEN PHU, A HOSPITAL WAS PREPARED FOR 25 BEDS. WITH THE 
EXPECTATION THAT WOUNDED COULD BE FLOWN OUT. HUNDREDS OF WOUNDED Now 
HAVE NO BEDS AT ALLe 

STEADILY THE PERIMETER OF THE MAIN FORTRESS IS FORCED INWARD. 

HERE IS WHERE BRIG. GEN. CHRISTIAN DE CASTRIES OPERATES WITHIN 4 DEEP 
EARTHERN BUNKER. THERE ARE OUTLYING STRONG-POINTS BUT HIS DEFENSE LINE,

IS SHRUNK TO A DIAMETER OF 1 1/4 MILES. THAT I$ ABOUT THE DISTANCE FROM 
THE WHITE HOUSE TO THE CAPITOL IN WASHINGTON. ENEMY TRENCHES ARE WITHIN 
700 YARDS OF DE CASTRIES' DEFENSE BUNKER. 

THE BATTLE NOW IS NIP AND TUCK, AND CORRESPONDENTS FROM THE 
FIELD WARE WRITING MORE PESSIMISTIC REPORTS. 

IF THE FORTRESS HOLDS UNTIL THE MONSOON MAKES DEFENSE PERHAPS 
FASITER--AND THERE ARE DEBATES ABOUT THAT--FRANCE WILL TAKE GREAT COURAGE 
FOR THE FIRST TIME SINCE THE WAR STARTED, THE COUNTRY HAS SHOWN SOME 
SIGNS OF TAKING PRIDE IN ITS EFFORT IN INDOCHINA.

(300) PHONE MONITORING 
APRIL 23 (AP )-WHAT DOES THE LAW SAY ABOUT THE MONITORING 
F TELEPHONE CALLS? 
‘ IT SAYS CIN THE FEDERAL COMMUNICATIONS ACT OF 1934) THAT IF A CALL 
IS RECORDED IT CANNOT BE MADE PUBLIC WITHOUT THE CONSENT OF THE PARTY 
ON THE OTHER END OF THE LINE. BUT IT DOES NOT MAKE THE ACT OF RECORD- 


ING ILLEGAL. 

THAT OPINION, WHICK SQUARES WITH THE UNDERSTANDING OF GOVERNMENT 
LAWYERS FAMILIAR WITH COMMUNICATIONS STATUTES, WAS HANDED DOWN BY 
ATTORNEY RAY JENKINS TODAY AFTER A DAY OF WRANGLING OVER THE MONITORING 
AT THE PENTAGON OF A PHONE CONVERSATION BETWEEN SENATOR MC CARTHY (R- 
WIS) AND SECRETARY OF THE ARMY STEVENS. THE TALK HAD BEEN TAKEN DOWN 
IN SHORTHAND BY 4 STEVENS* AIDE LISTENING IN. 

JENKINS, COUNSEL FOR THE SENATORS INVESTIGATING THE MCCARTHY-PENTA- 
GON ROW, PUT THE LEGAL SITUATION THIS WAYS 

NOT VIOLATION OF THE LAW TO MONITOR. IT I$ A VIOLATION 
TO DIVULGE WITHOUT THE CONSENT OF THE SENATOR (MCCARTHY). 
| MCCARTHY, IN HIS FIRST EXPLOSIVE REACTION WHEN HE DISCOVERED HIS 

CALL HAD BEEN MONITORED, HAD CALLED THE ACTION “ILLEGAL” AS WELL 4S 
INDECENT. 

TONIGHT HE WAS TAKING THE POSITION THAT THE INVESTIGATORS SHOULD 
SUBPOENA ALL RECORDS OF PHONE CONVERSATIONS IN THE DISPUTE AND INTRO- 
DUCE INTO EVIDENCE ALL THOSE DEEMED PERTINENT, WITHOUT ASKING THE - 
CONSENT OF ANYONE. THIS WOULD APPEAR TO CONFLICT WITH THE VIEW THAT 
UNDER THE LAW CONSENT MUST BE OBTAINED. 

THE STENOGRAPHER WHO TOOK DOWN THE MC CARTHY-STEVENS PHONE TALK 
WAS NOT OPERATING UNDER A RESTRICTION WHICH THE FEDERAL COMMUNICATIONS 
COMMISSION LAID DOWN ABOUT FIVE YEARS “AGO WITH REGARD TO THE USE OF 


Mm AUTOMATIC RECORDING DEVICES ON TELEPHONES. 


; THE FCC RULED THAT WHEN SUCH MACHINES WERE USED THEY MUST EMIT 4 

1 "BEEP" EVERY 15 SECONDS TO WARN THE PERSON AT THE OTHER END OF THE LINEes 
BUT A STENOGRAPHER DOESN'T HAVE TO BEEP.

(ADVANCE) SEOUL, SUNDAY, APRIL 25 (AP)-PRESIDENT SYNGMAN RHEE 
SAID TODAY SOUTH KOREA CAN’ACCEPT ONLY ONE SOLUTION AT THE GENEVA CON- 
FERENCE. STARTING TOMORROW--WITHDRAW COMMUNIST TROOPS FROM NORTH 
KORE\, THEN HOLD A NATIONWIDE SPRING ELECTION UNDER Us Ne SUPERVISION. 
HE DOESN'T EXPECT THE COMMUNISTS EVER TO AGREE TO THIS, THINKS THEY | 
MUST BE DRIVEN OUT BY FORCE. 
HE COUNTS ON THE UNITED STATES JOINING WITH SOUTH}/KOREA IN WALKING 
OUT OF THE GENEVA CONFERENCE IF 90 DAYS OF EFFORTS™FAIL TO_ BRING 
PROGRESS ON UNIFICATION. BUT SOUTH KOREA WILL NOT "ADAMANTLY OPPOSE” 
ANY RAISING OF THE INDOCHINESE QUESTION BEFORE THE 90 DAYS ARE UP. 
SOUTH KOREA WILL, HOWEVER, FIGHT ANY MOVE TO LINK THE SOUTH KOREAN 
AND INDOCHINESE QUESTIONS IN A BARTER DEAL. 
RHEE GAVE HIS VIEWS IN 4 10-PAGE TYPEWRITTEN REPLY TO QUESTIONS 
FROM THE ASSOCIATED PRESS. 
"COMMUNISM HAS NEVER YIELDED A SQUARE INCH OF SOIL ANYWHERE EXCEPT 
AS THE RESULT OF ARMED FORCE AND THERE IS NOT THE SLIGHTEST HINT 
THAT THERE IS, OR EVER WILL BE, ANY CHANGE IN THE POLICY,” RHEE SAID. 
"THE SOVIET IS BENT UPON WORLD CONQUEST AND WILL NEVER WILLINGLY 
SACRIFICE ITS HOLD ON SUCH A STRATEGICALLY USEFUL TERRITORY AS KOREA." 
RHEE EXPRESSED CONFIDENCE THAT "IT SALLIES WILL STAND BEHIND US 
IN THE EVENT OF FURTHER HOSTILITY~” 
3UT HE SAID IF SOUTH KOREA WERE ABANDONED, IT COULD ONLY TRY TO 
CHOICE OF DEATH To 


FIGHT ON ALONE SINCE "EVERY KOREAN PREFERS THE 
THAT OF CONTINUED DIVISION." 
RHEE WARNED AGAINST ANY “FAKE WITHDRAWAL" OF COMMUNIST TROOPS FROM 
HE SAID THIS MIGHT BE TRIED IN ORDER TO LURE Us Ne TROOPS 
INTO LEAVING SOUTH KOREA AND OPENING THE WAY FOR A NEW ATTACKe

THE SOLIDARISTS--AS THEY PREFER TO CALL THEMSELVES--WERE ORGANIZED 
IN BELGRADE, YUGOSLAVIA, 24 YEARS AGO BY A SMALL GROUP OF FUGITIVE

SINCE THEN THEY TOLD ME, THEIR AGENTS HAVE SPREAD INTO EVERY BIG 
CITY IN RUSSIA AND HAVE ICFELTRATED THE ARMY, THE COMMUNIST PARTY AND 
THE SECRET POLICE. 

WHEN I TALKED TO THEM THE SOLIDARISTS WERE SEEKING RECOGNITION AND 
SUPPORT IN THE UNITED STATES. THE KREMLIN'S ACTIONS THIS WEEK 
INDICATE THEY HAVE WON RECOGNITION AT LEAST IN THE SOVIET UNION. 

THEIR LEADERS SAID THE OBJECTIVE OF THE NTS WAS THE EVENTUAL 
OVERTHROW OF THE SOVIET REGIME FROM INSIDE RUSSIA.

LIES IN RUSSIA AND BREAK DOWN THE RUSSIAN FEAR OF THE SECRET POLICE. 

THE SOVIET'S MAIN WEAPONS ARE FEAR AND LIES. BREAK THAT DOWN AND 
THEN WE CAN THINK OF REVOLT, BUT NOT BEFORE.®

JOHN FOSTER DULLES HAS BEEN AMERICA'S FORRIGN*MOMLCY. CHIEF FOR LESS 
THAN 16 MONTHS. TAKING OVER AS SECRETARY OF STNFEAFTER 4A LONG 
CAREER IN CORPORATION LAW AND PART-TIME DIPLOMACY, HE HAS CLOCKED WELL

TODAY'S ears auc FOLLOW-UP TO THE BERLIN BIG FOUR CONFERENCE IN ° 


FEBRUARY, IS HIS SECOND HEAD-ON ENCOUNTER WITH TOP RUSSIAN 
NEGOTIATORS SINCE HE TOOK OFFICE UNDE? PRESIDENT EISENHOWER. 

SON OF A PRESBYTERIAN MINISTER AND GRANDSON OF A SECRETARY OF 
STATE, THE 65-YEAR-OLD DULLES IS NO NOVICE IN WORLD POLITICS. FORTY 
YEARS OF TRAINING IN INTERNATIONAL LAW AND DIPLOMACY HAVE MADE HIM 
SKILLED NEGOTIATOR. HE HAS A NATURAL AIR OF ASSURANCE AND BUOYANCY. 
HIS COUNTRY-SQUIRE APPEARANCE BELIES HIS TALENT 4S A BARGAINER. 

IN HIS ROLE AS REPUBLICAN PARTY FOREIGN AFFAIRS EXPERT, HE HAS BEEN

SAN_ERANCISCO. APRIL 26 (AP)-THREE MEN AND A WOMAN WERE 
CONVICTED IN FEDERAL COURT TONIGHT OF HELPING COMMUNIST LEADER 
ROBERT THOMPSON HIDE OUT IN A MOUNTAIN CABIN. ve 

A JURY OF 7 WOMEN AND FIVE MEN FOUND SIDNEY STEINBERG) 4 
CARL ROSS) 41, AND SAMUEL COLEMAN, 43, ANDMRS. SHIR EMEN, 
22, GUILTY OF ALL COUNTS AGAINST THEM. 


THE FOUR WERE ARRESTED AT A HIGH SIERRA CABIN LAST AUG. 27 WITH 
THOMPSON, CONVICTED IN NEW YORK AND SENTENCED TO PRISON AS ONE 
OF THE 11 TOP REDS IN THE UNITED STATES. 

STEINBERG, A NATURALIZED LITHUANIAN AND FORMER NATIONAL 
SECRETARY OF THE COMMUNIST PARTY, WAS CONVICTED ON COUNTS OF BEING 
AN ACCESSORY TO THOMPSON'S OFFENSE UNDER THE SMITH ACT--CONSPIRACY TO 
ADVOCATE AND TEACH THE FORCIBLE OVERTHROW OF THE GOVERNMENT--AND OF 
HARBORING THOMPSON. ‘FAcuce 

ROSS, A NATIVE OF MICHIGAN AND FORMER SECRETARY OF THE MINNESOTA 
COMMUNIST PARTY; COLEMAN, A MEMBER OF THE NEW YORK COMMUNIST ORGANI- 
ZATION, AND MRS. KREMEN, FORMER LOS ANGELES CITY COLLEGE STUDENT, 
WERE CONVICTED ON THE SAME COUNTS AS STEINBERG. 

AND IN ADDITION, THE THREE WERE CONVICTED ON TWO COUNTS EACH OF 
HARBORING AND CONCEALING STEINBERG. 

POSSIBLE PENALTIES RANGE UP TO 10 YEARS IMPRISONMENT AND $15,000 
OR MORE IN FINES FOR EACH DEFENDANT.

OF THE 11 TOP REDS IN THE UNITED STATES. 

STEINBERG, A NATURALIZED LITHUANIAN AND FORMER NATIONAL 
SECRETARY OF THE COMMUNIST PARTY, WAS CONVICTED ON COUNTS OF BEING 
AN ACCESSORY TO THOMPSON'S OFFENSE UNDER THE SMITH ACT--CONSPIRACY TO 
ADVOCATE AND TEACH THE FORCIBLE OVERTHROW OF THE GOVERNMENT--AND OF 
HARBORING THOMPSON. FAcuce

ZATION, AND MRS. KREMEN, FORMER LOS ANGELES CITY COLLEGE STUDENT, 
WERE CONVICTED ON THE SAME COUNTS AS STEINBERG.

HARBORING AND CONCEALING STEINBERG.

FOR THE FRENCH THE TASK WAS TO TIGHTEN THE DEFENSE BULWARK AS MUCH 
AS POSSIBLE. ALL AROUND THE MAIN DEFENSE AREA THE VIETMINH WERE 
CHIPPING SLOWLY AWAY AT KEY SPOTS. THE FRENCH OPERATIONAL 
HEADQUARTERS OF BRIG.GEN«CHRISTIAN DE CASTRIES WERE LESS THAN 600 
YARDS FROM ADVANCED POSITIONS OF STRONG VIETMINH FORCES. 

ON THE RIM OF THE FORTRESS THE VIETMINH SET UP MORE MACHINEGUN 
NESTS AND ANTI-AIRCRAFT BATTERIES TO TRY TO SHOOT DOWN THE PLANES 
WHICH PARACHUTE MEN AND MATERIAL INTO THE FORTRESS. 

AS LONG AS THE NARROW "DROPPING ZONE” IS HELD IN THE HEART OF 
THE FORTRESS IT CAN GO ON LIVING AND RESISTING. BUT A FRESH 
BIG PUSH FROM ANY OF THE ENCIRCLING POINTS HELD BY THE VIETMINH COULD 
PUT THEM VIRTUALLY IN THE DROPPING AREA. IF THAT HAPPENS THE 
LIFELINE FOR THE FORTRESS WOULD BE GONE AND THE FINAL CHAPTER WOULD 
BE WRITTEN IN BLOODY HAND-TO-HAND COMBAT. 

THE HEAVY RAINS SLOWED DOWN MOVEMENT OF FRENCH TANKS AND 
ARMORED VEHICLES. THE AIR ARM, JUST STRENGTHENED WITH AMERICAN- 
SUPPLIED CORSAIRS, WAS FORCED {NTO VIRTUAL IDLENESS&lt;« 

BUT THE RAINS WERE EXPECTED TO SLOW THE MOVEMENT OF SOVIET-MADE 
MOLOTOV TRUCKS CARRYING SUPPLIES FROM THE CHINESE BORDER TO THE 
VIETMINH AROUND DIEN BIEN PHU. 

THE RAINS ALSO HIT THE DELTA AREA AROUND HANOI. BUT THE 
FRENCH REPORTED KILLING 75 VIETMINH AND CAPTURING 30 IN SCATTERED 
MOPUPS AROUND HANOI, INCLUDING 20 KILLED IN AN ACTION 12 MILES 
SOUTHWEST OF THE CIty.

PHILIP MCBRIDE ANNOUNCED TODAY THE 51 RUSSIANS OF THE CLOSED-DOWN rf 
SOVIET EMBASSY HERE WILL HAVE THE EXCLUSIVE RUN OF THE 20,256-TON __ 
BRITISH SHIP NEW AUSTRALIA FOR THEIR TRIP BACK HOME. 

IN A PRESS STATEMENT, MCBRIDE SAID THE PARTY OF EMBASSY OFFICIALS 
AND THEIR FAMILIES WILL BE FLOWN THURSDAY IN A CHARTERED PLANE FROM 
CANBERRA TO PERTH, WESTERN AUSTRALIA, TO BOARD THE VESSEL AT THE 
NEARBY PORT CITY OF FREMANTLE. 

WITH THE WAY CLEAR FOR THE RUSSIANS TO LEAVE, MCBRIDE SAID IT Now 
IS EXPECTED “THAT THE DEPARTURE OF THE AUSTRALIAN EMBASSY STAFF FROM 
MOSCOW WILL _NOT BE FURTHER DELAYED. 

SINCE RUSSIA BROKE OFF RELATIONS WITH THIS COUNTRY LAST WEEK OVER 
THE PETROV CASE. THE SOVIET FOREIGN OFFICE HAD BEEN HOLDING UP EXIT 
VISAS FOR CHARGE D'AFFAIRES BRIAN HILL AND SEVEN OTHERS INCLUDING Two 
CHILDREN AT THE SMALL AUSTRALIAN EMBASSY IN MOSCOW. THE RUSSIANS SAID 
THEIR DEPARTURE WAS "CONDITIONAL ON DEVELOPMENTS IN AUSTRALIA. 

RUSSIA BROKE OFF RELATIONS LAST WEEK OVER THE CASE OF VLADIMIR 
PETROV, WHO FLED HIS JOB AS SOVIET THIRD SECRETARY AND HANDED OVER 
TO AUTHORITIES HERE A MASS OF DOCUMENTS HE CLAIMED UNCOVERED A VAST 
RED SPY RING IN AUSTRALIA. 

THE RUSSIANS CLAIMED PETROV WAS A SWINDLER AND FORGER AND 
DEMANDED HIM BACK AS A COMMON CRIMINAL. THE AUSTRALIANS GRANTED PETROV 
POLITICAL ASYLUM AND ARE SIFTING THE PURPORTED SPY PAPERS HE HAD 
TURNED OVER. THE RUSSIANS ALSO CLAIMED THE AUSTRALIANS KIDNAPED MRS. 
PETROV, WHO WAS PERMITTED TO REJOIN HER HUSBAND AT THE LAST MOMENT 
BEFORE A PLANE WAS TO TAKE HER BACK TO EUROPE UNDER SOVIET GUARD. THE 
AUSTRALIANS REJECTED BOTH CLAIMS. 

AS ALL AVAILABLE AIR SPACE ALREADY WAS TAKEN UP BY TOURISTS LEAVING 
FOR THE EUROPEAN SUMMER, THE RUSSIANS ASKED FOR SEA PASSAGE HOME.

WASHINGTON, APRIL 23 (AP)-THE MILITARY FUIURE OF COL. FRANK He 
SCHWABLE WAS SHROUDED IN UNCERTAINTY TODAY EVEN THOUGH HIS SUPERIORS 
HAD DECIDED NOT TO TRY THE BEMEDALED FLYING MARINE FOR SIGNING A 
FALSE GERM WARFARE CONFESSION WHILE A PRISONER OF THE REDS IN KOREA. ° 

THE MARINE CORPS YESTERDAY ANNOUNCED THE FINDINGS OF A SPECIAL 
COURT OF THREE GENERALS AND AN ADMIRAL WHICH SAT FOR A MONTH 
CONSIDERING THE CASE OF THE 45-YEAR-OLD COLONEL WHO HAS 23 YEARS 
OF SERVICE AND A WORLD WAR II COMBAT RECORD BEHIND HIM. 
SCHWABLE'S CONDUCT WAS “EXCUSABLE ON THE GROUND THAT IT WAS THE 
RESULT OF MENTAL TORTURE.” 

THE COURT'S RECOMMENDATIONS WERE REVIEWED AND APPROVED BY GEN... 
LEMUEL C.SHEPHERD, MARINE CORPS COMMANDANT, SECRETARY OF THE NAVY.) &gt; . 
\NDERSON AND SECRETARY OF DEFENSE WILSON. 

THE SPECIAL PANEL DID NOT SIT AS A COURT-MARTIAL. RATHER, IT 
wAS CONVENED TO SIFT THE EVIDENCE AND DECIDE WHETHER SCHWABLE, THE 
HIGHEST RANKING MARINE CAPTURED IN THE KOREAN WAR, SHOULD BE FORMALLY 
TRIED FOR MAKING THE CONFESSION THAT HE IMMEDIATELY REPUDIATED WHEN 
FREED AFTER 14 MONTHS IN CAPTIVITY. 

ITS RECOMMENDATIONS COULD SET A PRECEDENT FOR THE HANDLING OF 
ONE OTHER MARINE AND 33 AIR FORCE PILOTS WHO MADE SIMILAR CONFESSIONS 
WHILE IN COMMUNIST HANDS. THE REDS MADE PROPAGANDA USE OF THESE 
CONFESSIONS IN AN EFFORT TO PROVE TO THE WORLD THAT THE UsNs FORCES 
USED BACTERIOLOGICAL WEAPONS AGAINST THE CHINESE AND NORTH KOREANS. 

DURING HIS MONTH-LONG HEARING THAT ENDED MARCH 15, SCHWABLE DETAILED 
IN GRAPHIC TERMS THE PHYSICAL DEGRADATION AND MENTAL TORTURE TO 
WHICH THE REDS SUBMITTED HIM BEFORE HE BROKE AND SIGNED THE CONFESSION.

STRESS--A “SEVERE BLOW TO THE NATIONAL INTEREST BY ONE WHOSE SOLE

FT. BRAGG, NoCey APRIL 23 (AP)-THE ARMY NOT ONLY IS TESTING NEW . 
ATOMIC WEAPONS IN CAROLINA WAR GAMES. IT'S ALSO GIVING CLOSE 42 TEN- : 
TION TO A NEW TYPE INFANTRY REGIMENT DESIGNED TO PLACE MORE 
FIREPOWER IN THE HANDS OF THE FRONT LINE GI. 

4S AIR FORCE PLANES LEFT TODAY TO FLY 10,000 TROOPS OF THE 37TH 

LAs, TO A MOCK ATOMIC WAR HERE-- 

1,000 MILES AWAY--ARMY PLANNERS KEPT THEIR EYES ON THE PERFORMANCE OF 
THE 325TH INFANTRY REGIMENT OF THE 32ND AIRBORNE DIVISION. 

FOR SEVERAL MONTHS NOW THE 325TH HAS BEEN OPERATING UNDER A NEW 
TABLE OF ORGANIZATION THAT THE WORLD WAR II SOLDIER WOULD HAVE DIFFI- 
CULTY RECOGNIZING. BASICALLY, IT ELIMINATES THE HEAVY WEAPONS COMPANY 
OF THE INFANTRY BATTALION AND PUTS ITS HEAVY MACHINE GUNS IN THE 
BATTALION’S THREE LINE COMPANIES. OTHER ELEMENTS OF THE HEAVY WEAPONS 
COMPANY, SUCH AS THE MORTAR PLATOON, HAVE BEEN PLACED IN THE BATTALION 
HEADQUARTERS COMPANY. 

ALTHOUGH THE ARMY DOESN'T PLAN TO KEEP THE NEW TYPE ORGANIZA- 

TION, KNOWN AS THE FALCON REGIMENT, PARTS OF IT MAY BE INCORPORATED 
INTO UNITS FOR TOMORROW'S PUSH-BUTTON WARFARE. 

ANOTHER CHANGE IS THE ADDITION OF TWO MEN TO A RIFLE SQUAD WHICH 
NOW HAS TWO AUTOMATIC RIFLES INSTEAD OF THE ONE BAR THAT THE NINE- 
MAN WORLD WAR IL INFANTRY SQUAD CARRIED. THIS CHANGE, SIMILAR TO THE 
MARINE SQUAD, RESULTED FROM KOREA. THERE SQUADS, DISREGARDING STRICT 
ORGANIZATION RULES, WOULD PICK UP AN EXTRA AUTOMATIC RIFLE WHENEVER 
POSSISLE 10 STOP THE CHARGING COMMUNISTS.

IG RAISING IS A MAJOR ISSUE CONFRONTING THE KNESSET (PARLIAMENT). 

THE ORTHODOX, WHO PREDOMINATE, ARE AGAINST IT, OF COURSE, AND I HAVE 
BEEN TOLD BY RESPONSIBLE SOURCES THAT IF A POLL OF THE POPULATION 
COULD BE TAKEN, PROBABLY A MAJORITY WOULD VETO PIG RAISING. 

BUT FARMERS, BOTH CHRISTIAN ARAB AND SOME JEWISH, HAVE FOUND HOG 
RAISING A PROFITABLE BUSINESS AND CONTINUE DESPITE THE PROTESTS OF THE 
RABBIS AND THE RELIGIOUS GROUPS. 

IN THE END IT IS QUITE LIKELY THAT HOG FARMERS WILL BE PUT OUT oF 
BUSINESS, FOR EATING PIG MEAT IS FORBIDDEN IN THE MOSAIC LAW AND I$ 
CONTRARY TO JEWISH BELIEF AND TRADITION.

IMMIGRATION, WHICH AT ONE TIME RAN INTO THE HECTIC FIGURE OF 1,000 
A DAY BROUGHT INTO THE COUNTRY APPROXIMATELY 720,600 PERSONS IN Liss 
THAN FIVE YEARS, HAS, FOR ALL PRACTICAL PURPOSES, FOLDED UP. IT HAS 
SLOWED DOWN To A TRICKLE. 

LAST YEAR ONLY 8,000 CAME INTO THE COUNTRY AND ABOUT THE SAME 
NUMBER DEPARTED--EMIGRATED TO OTHER PLACES OR RETURNED TO WESTERN 
AND CENTRAL EUROPE. 

THE ENDING OF IMMIGRATION IS ATTRIBUTED TO TwO REASONS. ONE, ONLY 
A RELATIVELY FEw JEWS WHO COULD LEAVE THEIR NATIVE OR ADOPTED COUNTRIES 
ARE WILLING TO COME HERE. 

THE OTHER IS THAT A SELECTIVE SYSTEM HAS BEEN PUT IN FORCEN 
PRACTICALLY REVERSING THE EARLY POLICY OF UNRESTRICTED AND UNLIMITED 


IMMIGRATION. 

THIS BARS THE ACED, THE AILING AND THE SO-CALLED "HARD CORE” CASES 
WHO WOULD BECOME PUBLic CHARGES OR CHARITY PATIENTS. AND THOSE ARE 
THE ONLY ONES LEFT IN NORTH AFRICA AND EUROPE WHO ARE ASKING TO COME TO 
ISRAEL. THEN, OF COURSE, THERE ARE SEVERAL MILLION JEWS BEHIND THE [RON 
CURTAIN WHO ARE BELIEVED READY AND EAGER TO COME TO ISRAEL IF PERMITTED, 
BUT THE BARS ARE UP. 

THE MOST SIGNIFICANT ASPECT OF THE WHOLE IMMIGRATION-ABSORPTI ON

CAME IN DURING THE WAVE OF MASS IMMIGRATION FROM 1948 THROUGH 1953, 
MORE THAN 400,000 HAVE BEEN ESTABLISHED IN JOBS AND HOMES AND ARE TODAY
